name: Grid Cell Styler
tagline: Fluent cell renderers and editors for the Power Apps grid, driven by column type.
summary:
A grid customizer: it changes how the Power Apps grid draws and edits its cells, without replacing the grid. It is assigned to a table's grid rather than placed on a form.

- Text: long values truncated, with the full value in a tooltip
- Currency: coloured above and below a threshold of 100,000
- Yes/No: a mark beside the word, edited with a toggle
- Choice: coloured pills

Model-driven apps only, and one grid takes one customizer.

limitations: The grid is PCFHub's stand-in, not the Power Apps grid — cell renderers and editors run for real, the surrounding grid does not.
The full gridCustomizer interface (GetHeaderRenderer, GetLoadingRowRenderer, GetNoRowsOverlayConfiguration) and PAGridAPI are not exercised.
Sorting, filtering and paging are server-side in a real grid; the demo is one page of fixture rows.
Cell validation state is always clear: a fixture carries no attribute metadata, so validationError, secured and isRequired are never set.
